author: deram
quote: This game wasn't as good as I expected. I'd been waiting for over a decade for this release, and to be honest... It's not what I expected; I'd like the game to be different. The trailer showed beautiful graphics, but when I played it, no matter what console I played it on, whether it was my PlayStation or my friends', the game still wasn't what I expected, I'm really disappointed, but probably a lot of people liked it so I won't say I hate it.

author: deram
quote: This game seemed too good to me. I bought the Nintendo Switch 2 to play some games because they looked good, but none of them interested me as much as this one. I've never played the old version. I think this is one of the best games I've ever played, if not the best, and I haven't even finished it yet. I can't find a single flaw in it, and the graphics are absolutely gorgeous. I think I'm going to love it.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
